'''Ludvika''' is a female [[NPC]] working at the [[Averardo Vault (Instance)]]. 

==Quests and Events==
{{Quests and Events}}

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Ludvika:''' Hello there! Are you looking to sell any collectibles?
:{{DIcon}} What kind of items do you collect?
:'''Ludvika:''' Oh, all kinds. Literature from before [[The Lament|the Lament]], old currency, electronics, contemporary art, and precious metals.
:'''Ludvika:''' [[Averardo Vault]] values anything of significance—anything that speaks to [[Ragunna]]'s past of whispers of its future.
:'''Ludvika:''' Of course, value is subjective. Difference eyes see different worth.
:'''Ludvika:''' So we evaluate each collectible to determine its value.
:{{DIcon}} Sounds pretty rigorous.
:'''Ludvika:''' Ha, you needn't worry. A few years back, we paid quite a sum for a sealed metal canister.
:{{DIcon}} What was inside?
:'''Ludvika:''' Nothing. We believe it's a pet food can manufactured before the Lament, but due to a production error, it was never filled with anything.
:'''Ludvika:''' I understand your confusion. But that's precisely why we set such a high price. It's one of the last known artifacts from before the Lament.
:'''Ludvika:''' As I said, we consider value from every angle, often going contrary to popular belief.
:'''Ludvika:''' To us, these items are unquestionably priceless. 
:'''Ludvika:''' Enough small talk. Do you have anything you'd like us to evaluate? Artifacts? Maybe a Reserved [[Echo]]?
:{{DIcon}} What about [[Abby]]?
::'''Ludvika:''' ...Do you mean the Echo with human-level intelligence and communication skills?
::'''Ludvika:''' Honestly, we've never encountered something quite like that in the Vault!
::'''Ludvika:''' If you're willing to part with it... We'll be sure to come up with an offer you'll like!
::You tell Ludvika you're just kidding and decline her offer. She looks a little disappointed.
:{{DIcon}} I've got a backpack full of things I don't need.
::'''Ludvika:''' Yes... these are rare items indeed.
::'''Ludvika:''' But if I'm being honest, they likely hold far more personal meaning to you than they ever could to us.
::'''Ludvika:''' We'd hate to take something so dear from you. Perhaps you'll reconsider? 
::Memories of these collectibles flash through your mind. You decide to keep them as mementos of your journey.
:{{DIcon}} Nothing at the moment.
::'''Ludvika:''' I understand. [[Shell Credit]]s aren't the most important things in this world.
:'''Ludvika:''' If you ever change your mind, don't hesitate to stop by anytime.
{{Dialogue End}}
